# android-offline-notes

> Offline-first notes core for Kotlin with an outbox of idempotent operations, per-field last-writer-wins merge and duplicate-free sync against any backend port Kotlin library `io.github.trysac:android-offline-notes`, package
> `io.github.trysac.android_offline_notes`, MIT licensed, Kotlin 2 on Java >= 21, standard library only.
